scope: Design advice only. No production source, tests, Git state, network, connector, real Vault, or human relation review was mutated.

baseline.head: fb37dcd80fa4445d86872a9e03ecb6a720048596
baseline.working_tree: dirty conversion WIP is present; this advice depends only on the listed baseline files and must not imply acceptance of the WIP
baseline.existing_boundary: code-map prepare accepts caller source-path bytes and caller-declared repository/commit/path; staged capture is content-addressed and transaction-inspected, but neither proves that bytes are the Git blob at the declared commit nor records a multi-file same-commit observation

contract_advice.purpose: Add a zero-egress request/observation boundary for bounded official-code and configuration evidence while preserving the existing code-evidence-manifest.v1 and staged capture semantics.
non_goals: Do not add an agent-side GitHub or Git fetcher, clone, archive download, shell command, recursive repository traversal, model loader, or weights download.
Do not make a connector observation a human officiality judgment or automatically publish a paper-to-repository relation.
Do not alter legacy manifest, locator, repo-record, paper-code-alignment, or retrieval schemas in place.
Do not treat a normalized web page or excerpt as proof of exact source bytes or as a Git blob.
Do not write a real Vault; all generated material remains under the approved .work boundary until a separately accepted publication transaction.

request.binding: Bind paper_id, canonical repository and one explicit full commit. If source_association is supplied, it is an exact immutable source association/version reference; changing display head cannot retarget this request.
request.repository: Canonical owner/name only, normalized once and retained verbatim in the request; no alternate repository is selected by observation.
request.commit: Explicit full lowercase Git object ID. The request records git_object_format=sha1 or sha256 and the declared ID must have the corresponding 40 or 64 hex length. Existing legacy manifests remain subject to their 40-character commit contract.

target_shape.path_rules: Relative normalized POSIX path, no leading slash, empty component, dot component, dot-dot component, backslash, NUL, URL query, glob, wildcard, or recursive pattern. Each target is one file path; duplicate path/role entries refuse unless the request explicitly records a distinct bounded representation target.

budgets.rule: All limits are positive bounded integers and are part of the request digest. Refuse before connector invocation when target count or declared limits exceed the frozen profile; never silently truncate or omit a target.

transport.meaning: Requested connector constraints only; they are not observations.
rules: read_only and offline_connector must be true for the public agent boundary.
URLs, if present, are bounded target hints and must use an allowlisted host; URL content never substitutes for Git identity.
No arbitrary command, archive, clone, recursive path, or unbounded search field is accepted.

request.identity: Canonical request bytes are hashed with a domain-separated digest. Request identity includes every target, role, path, commit, association reference and limit so a caller cannot reuse an observation for a different source set.

observation.lineage: One immutable observation records one connector/session lineage. repository, commit, tree and object-format facts are observed once and every target must prove membership in that same commit/tree. A per-file call that could cross a directory replacement is not a valid collection.

rules: present requires git_type=file, a regular supported mode, exact observed_path equality, a blob_oid matching the declared object format, and evidence of the requested capability.
missing or inaccessible retains the requested path, reason code and bounded search/inventory scope; it never disappears from coverage.
mismatch records both requested and observed repository/commit/tree/path/blob facts and refuses success.
unsafe covers symlink, submodule, tree, executable or other non-approved mode/type according to the frozen role policy; no bytes are handed to code capture.
mode and git_type are independently checked. A same-content duplicate at another path is not the requested target.

git_proof.verification: For raw bytes, the host connector proves the commit/tree/path entry and Git blob object identity using the repository object-format header plus exact bytes. The contract stores the Git blob OID and ordinary SHA-256 of the raw payload separately; neither is substituted for normalized_sha256.
git_proof.normalized_only: A normalized text view may carry UTF-8, line, newline and normalized_sha256 evidence, but it cannot claim blob_oid proof or exact source authority. It remains unverified for byte-bound capture.
git_proof.duplicate_content: Two requested paths may legitimately report equal raw_sha256, normalized_sha256 and blob_oid. They still produce two logical target records and, when handed off, two manifests whose origin paths remain distinct.
git_proof.crlf: Preserve raw bytes and raw_sha256. Derive newline_style, ends_with_newline, line_count and normalized_sha256 with existing normalize_code_bytes/code_text_metadata. CRLF-to-LF normalization never changes the raw Git proof.

observation.coverage: coverage.complete is true only when every requested target is present with all required evidence. coverage.partial is explicit when any target is missing, inaccessible, normalized-only, unsafe or mismatched; no successful complete observation is manufactured from a subset.
observation.observation_hash: Hash the complete canonical observation, including target failures, connector facts, requested-path coverage, excerpts, capability flags and config evidence. Omitting a failed target or replacing an observed value after handoff invalidates the hash.

workflow: Resolve and validate paper_id and optional source_association against immutable local records; reject an unresolved or display-only reference before creating a request.
Construct one bounded request with one repository, one exact commit, explicit role-grouped paths and frozen budgets. Canonicalize and hash it before any observation.
Pass only the request bytes/reference to an approved host connector or external operator. The public Python process performs no network or repository access.

Receive one immutable observation. Verify request_sha256, repository, commit, tree, complete target set, path safety, mode/type, capability, byte limits and observation_sha256 in one retained session.

For each raw present target, verify Git commit/tree/path/blob facts and exact raw bytes. For normalized-only or metadata-only targets, retain the insufficiency state and do not upgrade it to source authority.

Run only the frozen data-only config parser on explicitly observed configuration files. Record parser profile, config SHA-256, exact line spans and rejected constructs; never import, execute, interpolate, instantiate or load a model.

Create an explicit source-file handoff for each raw, verified implementation/config/entrypoint file. The handoff carries observation_id, request_sha256, repository, commit, path, mode, git_type, blob_oid, raw_sha256 and exact source bytes into the existing staged capture request.
Let independent relation review evaluate officiality and paper/code claims. Only an accepted relation-review successor can enter the canonical publication flow and later catalog projection.
Keep the request, observation, handoffs and review as immutable evidence. A source-version or commit change creates a new request/observation/review lineage; it never mutates the old one.

outcomes_and_errors.complete_success: OBSERVED_COMPLETE only when every requested target has present status and required capability/proof.
outcomes_and_errors.partial: OBSERVED_PARTIAL when bounded observation returns any missing, inaccessible, normalized-only or otherwise incomplete target; retain all reasons and prohibit publication as complete source evidence.

errors.when: Malformed identity, path, role, budget, URL, duplicate target or unsupported transport.
The selected source association/version or request basis is no longer current; observed data cannot be rebound silently.
Observed repository differs from the requested canonical repository.
Observed commit or object format differs from the request.
A target is not proven against the one observed commit tree.
Observed path differs from requested path or path normalization is ambiguous.
Raw bytes, Git mode/type or blob OID do not agree.
Only normalized text or metadata was supplied where raw Git-verified bytes were required.
The config is outside the closed data-only grammar or exceeds parser limits.
A caller tries to publish or hand off a partial target set as complete.

outcomes_and_errors.refusal_rule: Every mismatch, missing, partial, unsafe and stale case is a typed refusal or explicit partial state with requested and observed facts retained. Never substitute an empty success, guessed locator, caller assertion or later display head.

evidence_types.A: The paper itself explicitly presents the repository as its implementation.
evidence_types.B: A paper-linked project page explicitly identifies the repository as the implementation.
evidence_types.C: Repository README or CITATION precisely refers back to the paper.
evidence_types.D: Independently evidenced author/control identity and an explicit implementation declaration.

rules: Store each signal with exact source URL/path, observed commit/version, line or excerpt locator, source hash, evidence role and reviewer identity.
A/B plus C is a preferred combination but not an automatic formula. A reviewed direct release without a reverse backlink may be official when the reviewer records the evidence gap and rationale.
C alone, same organization, similar names, a dependency/baseline link or a model-generated suggestion cannot establish officiality.
Explicit third-party reproduction may support unofficial; absence of evidence remains unverified_candidate or evidence_insufficient according to the review record.
Only an independent human or separately authorized relation reviewer can issue the decision. Observation code may propose signals but never upgrades canonical officiality.

capability_and_config.claim_rule: Present or partial capability claims cite exact observed source/config line spans or a clearly marked README-only statement. Absence requires an observed inventory and declared bounded search scope; an unfetched path is unverified, not absent.
capability_and_config.safe_parser: Use a frozen data-only parser profile with depth/node/string/byte limits. Reject imports, includes, tags, anchors, object constructors, interpolation, scripts, callable values, duplicate-key ambiguity and unknown executable extensions. Python model loading and arbitrary YAML constructors are forbidden.
capability_and_config.checkpoint_rule: Checkpoint URL, revision, license and observed metadata may be recorded without downloading weights; source code cannot claim checkpoint support without an exact cited observation.

handoff_and_publication.handoff_rule: One verified raw target yields one handoff and remains one logical origin path in the existing code-evidence-manifest.v1. A multi-file observation is the shared lineage container; it does not merge distinct manifests or permit path substitution.
handoff_and_publication.legacy_policy: Keep validate_code_evidence_manifest, validate_code_capture_binding, validate_code_locator, repo-record.v1 and paper-code-alignment.v1 byte-compatible. Legacy caller-declared manifests without an observation/handoff remain valid historical capture only and cannot be upgraded to Git-verified official source evidence.
publication_requirements: prospective catalog, retrieval and backup/restore validation
handoff_and_publication.version_rule: A new source commit, repository, path, display association or observation capability creates a successor relation. Existing code evidence and review records are never retargeted.

proposed_files.ownership_note: These are prospective paths for a separately frozen implementation packet; this review created none of them. Connector transport and human relation review remain outside public Python.

acceptance_cases: Same-commit multi-file collection succeeds only with one retained commit/tree lineage and complete target set.
Directory replacement between target observations cannot split the collection; commit/tree/path checks refuse it.
Repository, commit, object-format, tree, mode, type, path and blob mismatches each produce the named refusal with both sides retained.
Missing target, inaccessible target, partial collection and complete-set publication attempt remain explicit and cannot be silently omitted.
CRLF raw bytes preserve raw_sha256 and Git blob proof while normalized_sha256 and line metadata follow existing code contracts.
Duplicate bytes at two distinct logical paths remain two targets and two origin paths.
Normalized-only web text cannot create a byte-verified manifest or claim exact Git source authority.
Hostile traversal, symlink, submodule, tree, executable-mode and unbounded URL/path inputs refuse before handoff.
Config imports, constructors, tags, anchors, interpolation, scripts, duplicate-key ambiguity and limit overflow are rejected without execution.
Officiality shortcuts fail; direct-release-without-backlink can be reviewed with an explicit evidence gap; third-party reproduction remains unofficial or unverified per review.
Source-version change and display-head change create new lineage and do not retarget historical code evidence.
Zero-egress and no-real-Vault-write sentinels pass for request validation, observation validation, config parsing and source-file handoff.
blockers: Architect must freeze the successor schema and exact allowed implementation/test paths before any Builder writes.
The source-conversion clone is dirty and has no exact-head acceptance for its WIP; this advice relies only on the listed baseline files.
Actual official repository trials and human relation judgments remain open gates and are not represented by this design review.
